message: V_field is V_got, but this build only accepts V_want (Hermes 2.0.0 and later)
why: IR is deliberately not forward-compatible: 2.x reads only what 2.0.0 and later produce. Accepting an older artifact would mean interpreting fields whose meaning has changed since — a wrong answer that looks like a right one. There is no migration path on purpose: 1.x artifacts are rejected loudly instead of being silently misread.
fix: recompile the source with this compiler (2.0.0+)
if you must run a 1.x artifact, use a 1.x binary — do not hand-edit the version field
